mta.description: The default Mail Transfer Agent to use.

default_format.description: The default mailbox format for local storage.

local_recipient.description: The default local recipient for undeliverable or system mail.

debug_level.description: The level of debug information to log.

log_destination.description: Where to send log output (syslog, stdout, stderr, or file path).

retry_attempts.description: Number of times to retry failed mail delivery.

retry_delay.description: Seconds to wait between delivery retries.

enabled_transports.description: List of transport plugins to load (e.g., smtp, fetchmail, imap).

smtp_server.description: Hostname of the external SMTP relay.

smtp_port.description: Port of the external SMTP relay.

tls_enabled.description: Whether to use TLS for SMTP connections.

fetchmail_enabled.description: Whether to enable the fetchmail transport to retrieve mail.

poll_interval.description: Interval in seconds for fetchmail polling.

fetch_server.description: Hostname of the mail server to fetch from.

fetch_protocol.description: Protocol to use for fetching mail (pop3, imap).

fetch_user.description: Username on the remote mail server.

fetch_pass.description: Password for the remote mail server user.

delete_on_server.description: Whether to delete mail from the server after fetching.

imap_enabled.description: Whether to enable the local IMAP server.

imap_address.description: IP address for the IMAP server to listen on.
